community_terms.basis: Common player-facing Uma Musume state term; Mood/Mood Effect is the established terminology.

Common EN-version Power stat label. The zh-CN alias 力量 is ambiguous in ordinary prose and can also occur inside proper names such as 莱茵力量 (Rhein Kraft); known non-stat compounds/names are explicitly excluded so physical/metaphorical power and character identities are not normalized to the stat label.
Established Support Effect label; narrower than the already-canonical generic Mood state.
Repeated player-facing Support Effect bonus label in category 155; ordinary stat prose remains unscoped.

source_bridge_terms.note: 干劲 is the zh-CN bridge for the player-facing Mood state. Do not normalize it to generic Vietnamese wording such as 'Tinh thần' or 'Hứng khởi'.
